items.title: Hold a Bend business registration
items.description: The city requires a current business registration before specialty licenses are issued; the registration is renewed annually.

note: Only code excerpts for specific license types were found; the general renewal date was not confirmed.

items.title: Hold a Gresham business license
items.authority: City of Gresham Business License Section
items.description: Anyone doing business in or owning a business based in Gresham must hold a business license before the business begins; commercial, home-based, food cart and out-of-city operators use different applications.

items.title: Renew Hillsboro business license
items.description: A general business license is required for any business operating in Hillsboro; it renews annually on its anniversary with a notice during the month it expires and a 30-day grace period. Renewals are not paid online.

items.title: File Portland and Multnomah County business income taxes
items.description: Businesses with Portland-source income file the City Business License Tax and Multnomah County Business Income Tax through the Revenue Division; Metro supportive housing and Preschool for All taxes apply to higher-income owners.

items.title: Renew Salem business license
items.authority: City of Salem Permit Application Center
items.description: Renewal must be completed within 30 days of the license's expiration date; renewal forms and invoices are mailed in November.
